import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import http from "node:http";
import { connect } from "@al-ft/l1-node-transport";

export const bad = async (): Promise<number> => {
  const now = Date.now();
  const started = new Date();
  const jitter = Math.random();
  const response = await fetch("https://example.invalid");
  const sidecar = await import("../../l1-node-transport/src/client.js");
  void [randomUUID, http, connect, started, response, sidecar, process.hrtime.bigint()];
  return now + jitter;
};
